statement_en: Evidence on adding health-care drugs to formulated feed for mandarin fish is mixed. Two papers only claim it helps, saying disease has not been prominent and that such drugs should be added regularly. One paper measured it and found some better immune and liver indicators (lower IL6, lower AST, higher lysozyme) compared with live bait. The same paper also found higher kidney stress and apoptosis gene expression, lower MHCIIα, and no differences in many other immune genes or in kidney lesions, and most of the benefits were also seen with feed alone.
statement_zh: 鳜鱼配合饲料中添加保健药，效果并不一致。两篇文献只是说有好处：疾病问题尚不突出、应定期添加保健药。一篇实测研究发现，与活饵相比，添加动保组的IL6和谷草转氨酶较低、溶菌酶较高；但肾脏内质网应激和凋亡基因表达升高，MHCIIα降低，其他多数免疫基因和肾脏病变无差异，且多数有利指标单喂饲料组也同样出现。

statement_en: In one 2024 paper on mandarin fish, adding a health-care drug to the feed (compared with live bait) changed only a few gut and kidney gene markers, with mixed direction: gut xbp1 rose and casp9 fell, kidney TCRα rose but MHCIIα fell, and kidney NF-κB was lower. Most other stress, apoptosis, immune and inflammation genes did not differ between groups, and no disease or parasite outcome was reported.
statement_zh: 一篇2024年的鳜鱼研究显示，与活饵相比，饲料中添加保健药只改变了少数肠道和肾脏基因的表达，方向并不一致：肠道xbp1升高、casp9降低，肾脏TCRα升高但MHCIIα降低，肾脏NF-κB也较低。其他大部分应激、凋亡、免疫和炎症相关基因各组之间没有差异，文中也没有给出发病或寄生虫方面的结果。

statement_en: Three papers say that mixing herbal ingredients into the feed helps prevent disease in mandarin fish: viral disease when herbs and immune enhancers are fed in suitable amounts, and intestinal disease and bacterial gut infection when herbs such as Sanhuang powder, gallnut and allicin are fed for 3-5 days at 7-10 day intervals. These are authors' statements, and one further claim only says herbal feed was given during a trial to prevent disease, with no result reported.
statement_zh: 三篇文献认为，鳜鱼饲料中拌入中草药有助于预防疾病：适量投喂中草药和免疫增强剂可预防病毒性病害；用三黄散、五倍子、大蒜素等拌饵，每隔7-10天投喂一次、每次连续3-5天，可预防肠道疾病和肠道细菌感染。这些都是作者的说法，另有一条只说试验期间投喂了含中草药的饵料来预防疾病，没有给出效果。

statement_en: In one 2025 paper, hesperetin reduced SCRV infection in cultured EPC cells: it lowered viral nucleoprotein expression and cut virus-induced apoptosis (18.84% to 11.78% at 24 hours), with lower caspase-3 and caspase-9 activity but no clear change in caspase-8. These are cell-culture results, not tests in live mandarin fish, so effects on fish disease are not shown.
statement_zh: 一篇2025年的论文显示，橙皮素在EPC细胞中可减轻SCRV感染：降低病毒核蛋白表达，减少病毒诱导的细胞凋亡（24小时从18.84%降至11.78%），caspase-3和caspase-9活性下降，caspase-8无明显差异。这些都是细胞试验结果，并非在活体鳜鱼上的试验，因此对鱼体发病的效果尚未得到验证。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, a 17% high-fat diet (L17) worsened liver health in one paper: liver cells had more and larger lipid droplets and bigger vacuoles, which the authors read as fatty liver (hepatic steatosis), and lipid metabolism was disturbed through reduced fat breakdown and increased fat synthesis.
statement_zh: 在一项研究中,给鳜鱼投喂17%高脂日粮(L17)会损害肝脏健康:肝细胞脂滴面积增大、空泡变大,说明出现异位脂肪沉积和肝脏脂肪变性;同时脂肪分解不足、脂肪合成增强,肝脏脂质代谢紊乱。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, diets high in fat or carbohydrate were linked to worse liver health: one paper measured more liver oxidative damage (higher MDA) and lower antioxidant enzyme (CAT) activity, while other papers reported or inferred liver fat deposition, a higher visceral index, and activation of non-specific immunity. None of the claims directly measured disease or parasite outcomes, and none show a benefit.

basis.summary: Most claims are measured gene-expression and histology results from two papers (S502 and S067, both 2025, which appear to report the same study), and they consistently show high-level replacement raising inflammation and liver fat, while the quadratic or mixed claims show a lower point at moderate replacement, so I reported both as a level-dependent effect.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fish meal with SPCH at high levels (above about 37%) raised expression of inflammation-related genes in the midgut and increased liver fat deposition, while a moderate replacement level lowered the expression of some inflammatory genes (lowest at FM35). The effect on gut inflammation therefore depends on the replacement level, and the claims point to the p38 MAPK/NF-κB pathway.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，用大豆浓缩蛋白水解物（SPCH）替代鱼粉，替代水平较高（超过约37%）时，中肠炎症相关基因表达上调，肝脏脂肪沉积增多；适量替代时部分炎症基因表达反而较低（FM35组最低）。因此肠道炎症与替代水平有关，相关结果提示可能通过p38 MAPK/NF-κB通路起作用。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, high-lipid diets were linked to worse liver health: measured results show lipid build-up in the liver and viscera, raised liver and viscera indices, lipid-droplet-filled and vacuolated liver cells (at 16% or 160 g/kg lipid), and higher liver crude fat and triglycerides with weaker antioxidant capacity. Other papers only report or infer that excess dietary fat can cause fatty liver and metabolic or liver-bile disease; none of the claims show a benefit or no effect, and none measure infection or parasites directly.
statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，高脂日粮与肝脏健康变差有关：实测显示肝脏和内脏脂质沉积、肝体比和脏体比升高、肝细胞脂滴堆积且空泡化（脂肪水平16%，即160 g/kg），肝脏粗脂肪和甘油三酯升高、抗氧化能力下降。其他文献只是综述或推测脂肪过量会引起脂肪肝及代谢性、肝胆类疾病；所有结论均未显示益处或无影响，也没有直接测定感染或寄生虫情况。

Most evidence comes from other species (carp, grouper, Japanese seabass, largemouth bass) or is background statements, and no claim reports a direct measurement in mandarin fish.

statement_zh: 这三条结论都来自同一篇论文的背景介绍，说的是氨基酸诱食剂在其他种类上能促进食欲和摄食（牛磺酸及味觉相关氨基酸对鱼类、混合氨基酸对罗氏沼虾、甘氨酸加丙氨酸对真鲷）。效果并不一致：三种氨基酸的混合物不如两种氨基酸的组合，而且没有一条是在鳜鱼上得到的结果。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, unbalanced dietary amino acids were linked to poor feeding, low protein use, less muscle gain and more nitrogen excretion; in a 59-day feeding trial the amino-acid-balanced diet gave the highest protein retention and deposition. Appetite genes were mixed: compared with the amino-acid-deficient group, both feeding-promoting (npy, agrp) and feeding-inhibiting (cart) genes were significantly lower in the balanced group, and other claims about better feeding are background or stated aims rather than measurements.

statement_en: In one study on mandarin fish, a moderate dose of dietary hydroxyproline (about 1%) raised feed intake and shifted appetite-gene expression toward more appetite-promoting and less appetite-suppressing activity, so it may act as a feeding attractant. statement_en: Claims on Artemia as a first feed for mandarin fish larvae point in different directions. In one measured study, larvae fed Artemia had much lower survival than larvae fed silver carp larvae (43% vs 69%), much lower pepsin activity at 4 days, and higher lipase activity at 4 and 6 days. An older paper only proposes and infers that Artemia is palatable and meets basic nutritional needs.
statement_zh: 关于用卤虫作为鳜鱼苗开口饵料，各条结论并不一致。一项有测定数据的研究中，投喂卤虫的鱼苗成活率明显低于投喂鲢鱼苗的（43%对69%），4日龄时胃蛋白酶活性也低得多，但4日龄和6日龄时脂肪酶活性较高。另一篇较早的文献只是提出并推断卤虫适口、能满足鳜鱼苗的基本营养需要。

The other two claims only say that better artificial feeds are still needed, for digestive function, gut histology, palatability, composition and utilisation, without reporting a welfare effect.

basis.summary: The measured claims from several 2021–2026 papers split into worse-than-live-bait results (growth, intake, gut structure, enzymes) and equal or better results (growth, feed efficiency, survival), so I reported the disagreement and noted the large individual variation instead of giving one direction; background-only and descriptive claims carried less weight.}

statement_en: Across many papers, formulated feed for mandarin fish gives mixed results on feeding and welfare. Many measured studies found poorer outcomes than live bait fish: lower feed intake, growth and survival in some trials, weaker digestive enzyme activity, thinner or shorter intestinal structures, reduced peptide uptake, and anorexia or feed refusal. Others found equal growth or survival, or better growth, feed efficiency and gut development than with live prey (e.g. Xiangyun crucian carp), and individual fish differ widely in how well they accept the feed.
statement_zh: 关于鳜投喂配合饲料，各研究结果不一。不少实测研究显示，与活饵鱼相比，部分试验中摄食量、生长和成活率较低，消化酶活性偏弱，肠道结构变薄或绒毛变短，小肽吸收下降，还有拒食、厌食现象。也有研究发现生长、成活率与活饵或冰鲜鱼无显著差异，或者生长、饲料效率和胃肠发育优于饵料鱼（如湘云鲫），而且个体之间对饲料的接受程度差别很大。

strength.en: Of 87 claims that take a side: 66 in favour, 21 against or no effect. Neither side reaches 80%.

basis.summary: The success-rate claims come from several measured papers and carry the most weight, but the many background, measured and counterevidence claims on low or unstable success, intake, growth, gut and taste changes show the outcome is mixed, so I reported both.

statement_en: Most claims report that mandarin fish, which naturally eat only live prey, can be trained to accept formulated feed in a staged switch from live bait to dead bait to feed, with reported training success mostly around 70–96% and some studies reporting lower figures (47.8%–70%); growth was similar to live-fed fish in two studies. However, results are not uniform: some papers report unstable success, low intake, poor growth or loss of condition, anorexia and sugar-metabolism disorder, lower taste-receptor gene expression, and temporary digestive-enzyme suppression and gut tissue changes after the switch.
statement_zh: 多数研究表明，天然只吃活饵的鳜鱼可以通过从活饵到死饵再到配合饲料的逐步过渡来驯食，驯食成功率多报道在70%～96%左右，也有研究报道较低（47.8%～70%）；有两项研究显示驯化后生长与吃活饵的鱼无显著差异。但结果并不一致：有的报道成功率不稳定、摄食量下降、生长慢或消瘦，部分个体出现厌食和糖代谢紊乱，驯食后味觉受体基因表达下调，转食初期消化酶活性受抑制、肠胃组织结构发生变化。

statement_en: Most claims say feed attractants and stimulants improve palatability, appetite and feed intake in mandarin fish and help them accept artificial feed during training, but these are mostly stated or cited rather than measured. One paper reports the opposite: attractants only raised the share of feed swallowed once it was already in the mouth, with no gain in attack rate or overall training success.
statement_zh: 多数研究认为，诱食剂能改善饲料适口性、增强食欲、提高采食量，并有助于鳜驯食人工饲料，但这些多为论述或引用，实测的较少。也有一篇文献指出相反的结果：诱食剂只能提高已进入口咽腔饲料的吞咽比例，并不能提高攻击频率，也不能有效提高整体驯食成功率。

statement_en: The three claims only describe or suggest the practice and report no measured welfare effect. They say bait fish for mandarin fish should suit its feeding (right body size, no hard spines, slow swimming) during training, that choosing live bait well is a key way to make larval rearing more efficient, and that raising bait fish in cages or ponds is proposed because natural bait fish are short while live fish are still the main feed.
statement_zh: 这三条结论都只是描述或建议，没有给出对鳜鱼福利的实测效果。内容是：驯化期选用的饵料鱼要体型合适、无硬棘、游速慢，才便于翘嘴鳜摄食；优化活饵料鱼的选择是提高鳜仔鱼养殖效率的关键途径之一；配合饲料不成熟时仍主要投喂活鱼，而天然饵料鱼不足，因此建议研究用网箱或池塘培育饵料鱼。

statement_en: Two papers give feeding ratios for rearing mandarin fish fry: one keeps prey fish at about five times the number of juveniles, with a total stocking density of 20,000 to 30,000 juveniles per cubic metre, and the other advises a daily prey-to-fish ratio of 5 to 8 to 1 for spotted mandarin fish at 2.0 to 15.0 cm total length. Both state ratios rather than reporting a clear welfare outcome, so the effect on feeding welfare is not shown directly.
